posts.description: Superjobs is a job board for designers who care where they work. ~1,500 live roles from 700+ companies — and 400+ design-led teams are tracked directly through their public ATS feeds (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, SmartRecruiters), so you apply on the company's own site, not through a middleman. No accounts, no email walls, no recruiter noise. Filter by category or remote, read the real description, apply at the source. Built as one HTML file with vanilla JS — no framework, no build step.

posts.name: Jotform Website Widgets
posts.tagline: Build and embed no-code website widgets in minutes
posts.description: Upgrade your website with customizable no-code widgets. Create interactive experiences with reviews, booking, chat, popups, countdowns, FAQs, media galleries, announcements, and much more, then personalize every widget and embed it on any website in minutes.

posts.name: Pixel Art Adult Colouring Book
posts.tagline: Happy Coloring & Paint Drawing
posts.description: Relax, create, and bring beautiful pixel artwork to life with Pixel Art Coloring by Number. Whether you enjoy color-by-number puzzles or creative coloring books, this app offers a fun and calming way to unwind while making stunning pixel masterpieces.

posts.name: Xolora AI
posts.tagline: Your next ad decision, already clear.
posts.description: Xolora turns your Meta Ads reports into clear decisions about what to scale, pause, and test next.

posts.name: Moveat
posts.tagline: Client check-ins, photos and diets for personal trainers
posts.description: Moveat is the client tracking app for personal trainers. The client sends a check-in from their phone: weight, measurements, how they feel, three progress photos. The coach reads the curve, compares the photos over time, and writes the diet and the program. Calories and macros come from a food database, never an estimate. No AI decides anything here, the coach does. Body photos are kept in private storage with short lived signed links, hosted in the EU. Free for your first 2 clients.

posts.name: qRaptor
posts.tagline: Turn business intent into production AI apps
posts.description: qRaptor is the AI-Native Application Engineering & Execution Platform. Build production-ready apps and AI agents on one platform — humans and AI agents working as one, governed by design. Deploy anywhere, own your code.

posts.name: PyTutor — Escuela de Scripting
posts.tagline: Aprende Python de verdad, no de video
posts.description: Aprende Python de verdad: 60 desafíos reales, código desde el primer minuto, certificación al completar. Escuela de scripting gratuita.

posts.name: Lumina
posts.tagline: AI Workplace Wellness Companion
posts.description: Long hours on screens can lead to eye strain, poor posture, mental stress, and fatigue. Our Lumina AI Wellness app on Mac and Win (Beta), helps you spot these issues early through real-time monitoring of eye health, posture, and stress. With personalized wellness scores, guided desk exercises, break reminders, and actionable insights, Lumina helps you build healthier screen habits without disrupting your workflow. Try Lumina free for 3 days. Download it today and feel better while you work.

posts.name: Suppertime
posts.tagline: Solo travel, minus the solo part
posts.description: Solo travel apps make you swipe through strangers and hope. Suppertime skips all of it. Open the app anywhere in the world and see a live map of real plans nearby. Someone's hiking at 9, grabbing coffee at noon, out tonight. Tap to join the group chat, then show up in person. No swiping, no DMs. activity focused, not profiles.

posts.name: CrossLynk
posts.tagline: Cross-promotion network for SaaS & tech startups
posts.description: CrossLynk helps bootstrapped founders and SaaS builders acquire traffic for free. Just embed a lightweight JavaScript widget on your web app to display non-competing partner banners. Every impression earns you credits to promote your own product across our partner network. Key Features: • Zero ad spend required • Automated partner matching • Non-competing niche alignment • Privacy-first & lightweight integration

posts.name: UseToolAI
posts.tagline: A curated directory of AI tools with research-backed reviews
posts.description: Hand-picked AI tools across 8 categories. Every claim fact-checked through multi-agent deep research. Each tool has a clear "What Makes It Unique" section. Auto-generated comparison pages for quick decisions. Research-backed blog articles. No AI-generated fluff — verified against official sources, G2, and Reddit.

posts.name: Win Grep 1.0
posts.tagline: Visual grep for Windows. Filter logs & text without CLI/CMD
posts.description: Win Grep is a lightweight visual text filter for Windows that replaces complex terminal commands with an intuitive 3-pane UI (INPUT ➔ FILTER ➔ OUTPUT). Easily filter log files, perform multi-keyword searches in a single pass, clean text noise with Invert mode, and run set operations (merge/intersect/subtract) line-by-line. Features live Regex preview and Unicode support. 100% local, free on Microsoft Store, no background bloat.

posts.name: MC Pixel Art
posts.tagline: Photo to Minecraft blocks, with 3D preview & build order
posts.description: Upload any photo and get a Minecraft block-by-block build plan, matched in perceptual color space (not raw RGB), previewed in 3D with click-to-inspect blocks, played back step-by-step in build order, and exportable straight into WorldEdit or Litematica. 100% browser-side, free, no signup.

posts.name: Writely
posts.tagline: A calm writing space where AI only sees selected text
posts.description: Writely is a calm writing workspace built for focused drafting without intrusive AI. Write with autosave, browser recovery, formatting tools, document export, and optional AI actions that process only the passage you deliberately select—not the rest of your document. It is currently free and in public beta.

posts.name: HSK Exam Hub
posts.tagline: Prepare for the HSK exam with mock tests. Completely free!
posts.description: Practice and pass your HSK exams with confidence. Get unlimited access to real-format HSK mock tests covering listening, reading, and writing—completely free. Designed for international students, self-learners, and test-takers worldwide.

posts.name: FlowWorks Flyover
posts.tagline: Fly anywhere on Earth. Film nothing.
posts.description: FlowWorks Flyover turns any city or landmark into a cinematic 3D flythrough — no filming, no drone, no setup. Search a place and Google's Photorealistic 3D Tiles render it in seconds, with full camera control: pan, rotate, tilt, zoom. Free tier: unlimited flights, no signup. Pro ($9/mo) removes the watermark and adds saved routes. Also works as a Chrome extension — fly from whatever page you're on. Built for travel creators, trip planners, and anyone who wants to see a place before going.

posts.name: LaunchandLoop
posts.tagline: Beyond the Launch
posts.description: Launch your startup, compete with similar products, share milestones, showcase verified growth, and sell your SaaS—all on a platform built for the journey beyond launch.

posts.name: Vox Invite
posts.tagline: Personalized Video Communication & Event Management Platform
posts.description: Vox Invite turns one photo, one voice recording, one master script, and one recipient list into hundreds or thousands of personalized videos. Each video addresses its recipient by name and is linked to a private guest page. The system automatically handles production, email and WhatsApp delivery, delivery and view tracking, RSVP, personal QR codes, check-in, guest lists, galleries, and other event operations through one dashboard and one unified guest data model.

posts.name: Replyy
posts.tagline: Reply faster. Reply safer.
posts.description: Paste a difficult email — or a whole thread — and get a reply you can review and send. Replyy reads the full context and flags priority and risk before you write. No login, nothing stored, never auto-sent. Built solo for salespeople. Free to try; Pro adds thread mode.

posts.name: Zoshra
posts.tagline: Auto-tracks what you watch to build blends with friends
posts.description: Zoshra turns your viewing activity into a private social feed shared with the friends you choose. Its Chrome extension automatically tracks what you watch across YouTube and supported streaming services, so friends can discover the documentaries, interviews, podcasts, videos, movies, and shows you’re enjoying. Users can also showcase a snapshot of their watch activity through a profile link on their Instagram bios, Linktree, etc. https://zoshra.com/u/rishidv2005

posts.name: EasyDex
posts.tagline: Update your address once, not 20 times
posts.description: EasyDex is a contact-sharing platform that keeps everyone's details current. Change your address, phone, or email once and the update flows to every person — and every business — connected to you. No more calling your bank, insurer, and utilities after a move.
